creator: kevinfremon
title: SuperSchema founder wires his Trillion agent's 'Lift' growth sub-agent to Supabase funnel data so it researches each sign-up's website and sends personalised, human-sounding lifecycle emails

tools.name: Trillion
tools.detail: creator's own agent product; UI at localhost:7777 on screen; 'Lift' is a named growth/lifecycle sub-agent

tools.name: SuperSchema
tools.detail: creator's app; scans a site and shows which AI citations/recommendations it gets

tools.name: Supabase
tools.detail: product database connected directly to Trillion

claims: Goal: $1M ARR; this loop is 'probably one of the most impactful things' toward it
SuperSchema funnel: scan website -> see AI citations -> answer a few questions -> data captured
Trillion has direct access to all captured funnel data via Supabase
Sub-agent 'Lift' researches the person's website and emails them based on intent, 'in a very non used-car-saleswoman way'
Recipients are replying thinking Trillion is a real person (creator says he is not trying to deceive)
how_to_steps: Capture intent data in the onboarding/growth funnel and store it in Supabase
Connect the agent to the Supabase database
Set up a loop so each new funnel completion is picked up by a growth sub-agent
Sub-agent researches the lead's website, writes a personalised email matched to their intent, and sends it
Agent reports back; scale top-of-funnel once the loop works
on_screen_only: SuperSchema admin 'Growth Funnel' dashboard with stage counts 35 / 29 / 13 / 12 / 4 / 0 and conversion rates 82.9% / 44.8% / 92.3% / 33.3% / 0%
Trillion UI at localhost:7777 showing a space-like node graph of agents/memories with avatar row of sub-agents

Draft email overlay: 'Hey Cara, I know it has been a few days and you are probably juggling a lot, so I will keep this short. I keep coming back to that question we asked ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini: Do I know if I need a fractional COO or an executive coach for my business? That is exactly what your founders and CEOs are typing into AI right now...' with tags like 'goal, website_manager'
Hook captions: 'MILLION DOLLARS IN ARR GOAL', 'REACH OUT TO THESE PEOPLE AS IF SHE', 'NON-USED CAR'

relevance.why: Pattern of an agent doing researched lifecycle outreach from your own app's funnel data is directly applicable to a solo founder's SaaS; but it runs on the creator's unreleased Trillion product

implement_score.why: Replicable without Trillion: a scheduled Claude Code / cron agent reading new Supabase sign-ups, fetching their site, drafting an intent-matched email and sending via Gmail/Resend. Needs care around disclosure and spam rules

verify: Is Trillion publicly available or still waitlist (hellotrillion.ai)
Legal/ethical check: AI emails that recipients mistake for a human (disclosure, CAN-SPAM)
No reply-rate or revenue numbers given; 'working incredibly well' is anecdotal

gap.what: Adds the lifecycle-outreach use case (agent reads funnel data from Supabase, researches each lead's site, sends personalised follow-up); liked Trillion videos covered handoff notes, a board of advisors and design, not automated growth email
